name: Siem Reap
getting_there: Fly into Siem Reap Angkor International Airport, usually via Bangkok or Singapore.
tip: A multi-day temple pass lets you avoid rushing — hire a tuk-tuk for the day.
intro: Sunrise over Angkor Wat. That is Siem Reap in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Siem Reap
paragraphs: Siem Reap (Southeast Asia) is known for its heritage, culture and adventure experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to March.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly into Siem Reap Angkor International Airport, usually via Bangkok or Singapore.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: A multi-day temple pass lets you avoid rushing — hire a tuk-tuk for the day.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Siem Reap?
How do I reach Siem Reap?
faq.a: Fly into Siem Reap Angkor International Airport, usually via Bangkok or Singapore.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Siem Reap?
faq.a: Popular choices: Near Pub Street for nightlife; Riverside for quiet.
